scope: Pulse workflow controller and ReAct runtime; existing dirty changes preserved

details: Final unverifiable review results no longer pass an otherwise completed criterion.
An actionable final not_met result can reopen planning even when all prior stages passed.
Negative checks can accept an explicit non-zero exit when the verifier omitted the auxiliary citation field, but only when the stage goal/check declares a negative expectation.
Final task outcome retains a candidate result reference.
Final text includes a clean stage deliverable summary and filters raw tool/result dumps.
CLI resume task prompts explicitly inherit the prior task record.
Execution-summary follow-ups use a read-only response criterion instead of rerunning the original mutation plan.
A baseline test command may run after an initial read before an edit is required.
Chinese and English inspection, validation, and negated no-write phrases are classified as read-only unless an explicit edit action is present.
Standalone JSON toolCalls and full-width DSML provider envelopes are detected as unexecuted tool requests.
